source: WormAtlas / White lab notebooks + new EM, via OpenWorm ConnectomeToolbox
publication: Varshney et al. 2011, PLoS Comput Biol (CC-BY)
license: CC-BY (PLOS paper); bundled with attribution, see registry
completeness: Full somatic wiring excl. pharynx: 280 connected neurons + BWM aggregator 2194 directed chemical pairs (union of send/receive views, 0 weight conflicts resolved by max), 1031 directed gap-junction entries, 115 NMJ neurons aggregated to BWM. Name casing/leading-zero normalised (one source row 'avfl/avfr' merged). Nodes carry ids only (no cell-type/region metadata in this matrix).
limitations: Paper reports 281 matrix nodes; this export lists 280 distinct connected names (one node likely connection-free here). Gap-junction weights are contact counts, not conductances; no dynamics; pharyngeal neurons excluded; receive-view conflicts resolved by max weight.
